title: Design System: Experience Workspace author guide

body.purpose: Lesson paragraphs and lists, maximum measure 72ch.

caption.purpose: Breadcrumb, contents, pager labels, and footer.

motion.name: guide-color-transition
motion.purpose: Links and buttons only, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary action link
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%;padding:10px 18px;border:2px solid var(--brand-primary,#3b63fb);border-radius:var(--brand-radius,8px);background:var(--brand-primary,#3b63fb);color:var(--brand-on-primary,#fff);font-family:var(--brand-font,"Adobe Clean","Source Sans 3","Source Sans Pro",-apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.25;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:3px;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:break-word}.ds-primary:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Secondary action link
components.description: Page-colored action with muted border and ink text.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%;padding:10px 18px;border:2px solid var(--brand-muted,#505050);border-radius:var(--brand-radius,8px);background:var(--brand-surface,#fff);color:var(--brand-ink,#292929);font-family:var(--brand-font,"Adobe Clean","Source Sans 3","Source Sans Pro",-apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.25;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:3px;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:break-word}.ds-secondary:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-secondary{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Clear search
components.description: Shown for a nonempty query; the application resets results and restores input focus.
components.css: .ds-clear{min-height:48px;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;background:var(--brand-surface,#fff);color:var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);font-family:var(--brand-font,"Adobe Clean","Source Sans 3","Source Sans Pro",-apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.7;cursor:pointer}.ds-clear:hover{background:var(--brand-surface-alt,#f8f8f8)}.ds-clear:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-clear{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Topic search field
components.description: Visible label and neutral field; application code supplies live filtering.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label">Search topics<input class="ds-search-input" type="search" placeholder="Try "publish", "images", or "blocks""></label>

components.name: Guide navigation
components.description: Muted rail links; alternate-surface hover and bold blue current-page state.
components.html: OverviewPublishing checklist
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:var(--brand-font,"Adobe Clean","Source Sans 3","Source Sans Pro",-apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:14px}.ds-nav-link{display:block;margin:2px 0;border-radius:var(--brand-radius,8px);padding:8px 12px;color:var(--brand-muted,#505050);line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:3px;overflow-wrap:break-word}.ds-nav-link:hover{background:var(--brand-surface-alt,#f8f8f8);color:var(--brand-ink,#292929);text-decoration:underline}.ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]{background:var(--brand-surface-alt,#f8f8f8);color:var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);font-weight:700}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-nav-link{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Guide card
components.description: Flat bordered alternate-surface container with 16px body inset.
components.html: A card can group related content.

components.name: Topic directory group
components.description: Divided category row and linked topic descriptions; not a raised card.
components.html:
Review and publish

  • Preview and publish safely

    A practical preflight checklist and the difference between draft, preview, and live.
components.css: .ds-topics{display:grid;gap:8px 32px;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--brand-border,#dadada);color:var(--brand-ink,#292929);font-family:var(--brand-font,"Adobe Clean","Source Sans 3","Source Sans Pro",-apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif);line-height:1.7}.ds-topics-category{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.25}.ds-topics-list{display:grid;gap:24px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}.ds-topics-item{margin:8px 0}.ds-topics-heading{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25}.ds-topics-link{color:var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:3px;overflow-wrap:break-word}.ds-topics-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-topics-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-link,#3b63fb);outline-offset:4px}.ds-topics-description{margin:0;color:var(--brand-muted,#505050);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}@media(width>=700px){.ds-topics{grid-template-columns:160px 1fr}.ds-topics-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px 32px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-topics-link{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Empty search recovery
components.description: Neutral explanatory text; paired with announced count and clear-search action in the application.
components.html: No matching topics. Try a broader term or clear your search to see all topics.

narrative.overview:
Plain, readable documentation for new and occasional authors. Neutral flat surfaces, Spectrum blue controls, left-hand guide navigation, and readable lessons implement the confirmed direction. This is a project training resource, not official Adobe product documentation.

This system applies only to pages opting into `Template: guide`. Original non-guide boilerplate is outside its scope. The shipped implementation, not a fictional brand or a new aesthetic choice, is the source of the tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral flat surfaces and fine dividers.
Responsive topic navigation and live topic filtering.

rules.name: The Blue Roles Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, blue text uses the link role; primary blue remains a fill.

rules.name: The Flat Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Separate guide regions with neutral tones and dividers, not shadows or gradients.

dos: **Do** apply this system only to opt-in guide pages.
**Do** preserve readable measures, labeled search, current-page semantics, and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** use the observed dark-mode roles rather than carrying light-mode blue text into dark mode.
**Do** retain the training-resource distinction from official Adobe documentation.
donts: **Don't** introduce shadows, gradients, ornamental illustration, or fictional interface screenshots.
**Don't** replace the styled Adobe text with an invented logo or use red as a control fill.
**Don't** turn the reading font stack into a system-display identity.
